segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Hi, Nora Bell here. Is the office still on the second floor? I am outside for my appointment.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, second floor, suite 204. The elevator is just past the lobby desk.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I see it now. That is all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You are welcome. Come up when you are ready.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Good morning, Colacci Law.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Evan Reed. I have never used your office. Do you take questions about a lease deposit?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The lawyer would need to decide whether that is something he can help with. We can offer an initial conversation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am only checking today. I want to gather my paperwork before asking for an appointment.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: All right. You can call back when you are ready.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Okay, I will leave it there for now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Buenos días, soy Lucía Soto. ¿Puedo entregar una copia en vez del documento original?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Para dejarlo en recepción, sí, una copia está bien. Si el abogado necesita el original, se lo dirá.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Perfecto, entonces guardaré el original en casa. Solo quería confirmar eso.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: De acuerdo, que tenga buen día.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: This is Daniel Moss. I left a question about the letter I received, and I would like the lawyer to call me back.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: What would you like me to put in the message?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Whether he has had a chance to read it. There is no new date on it that I can see.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I have written that in the message. I cannot give you a callback time.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: That is fine. The number already on my file is the one to use.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Hello, Priya Lane calling. I received the appointment directions, but the attachment opens as a blank page.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Let me check. I can read the parking directions over the phone now: use the visitor spaces behind the building.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: That helps. Could you also send me a readable copy?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, I will resend the directions this afternoon.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Thank you. I will look for them later.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Colacci Law, good afternoon.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is this the pharmacy on Main Street?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No, this is a law office.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Sorry, wrong number.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No problem.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Me llamo Mateo Cruz. ¿La primera conversación puede ser en español? Todavía no quiero reservar.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Podemos recibir su consulta en español. Antes de fijar una cita, necesitamos saber de qué se trata.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Entiendo. Voy a hablar con mi hermana primero; ella tiene los papeles. Hoy solo quería preguntar por el idioma.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Está bien. Cuando llame otra vez, explique brevemente el asunto.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Gracias, eso era todo.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Ruth Ellis here. I am checking that you received the envelope I dropped off this morning.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I have the reception log in front of me. It shows an envelope from Ruth Ellis received at ten fifteen.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Great. I was not asking whether anyone had reviewed it, just whether it arrived.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, receipt is logged. I cannot tell you whether it has been reviewed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: That answers my question.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am calling about the meeting. I thought it was—

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Could you give me your name and which meeting you mean?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The one with… [line breaks up]

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot hear you. Are you still there?

segments.speaker: unknown_participant
segments.text: [connection ends; no further words captured]

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Hi, it is Owen Park. The reminder says four, but my calendar says three. What time is my appointment?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I am looking at the appointment list. Your appointment is at four on July twenty-second.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: July twenty-second at four. I have corrected my calendar now.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Good. Is there anything else?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: No, that is everything.
